concepts.gloss_en: The seven lamps (of the menorah) — the object itself, a mystical structure mapped onto the seven facial orifices / seven clouds / seven wedding days
The sanctification of the seven lamps — the act/state of sanctifying, NOT the lamps themselves (construct head = kedushah / act of sanctifying)

members.note: verbal relative clause 'that one sanctifies the seven lamps'; same act of sanctifying the lamps, both in lm1:21 and tied to the same causal chain (tzaakah → mochin → sanctifying the lamps). Different grammatical head (verb vs noun) so not orthographic, but same referent-act

notes: Per rule 4, an action/state about X is not X: the lamps themselves (שבעת הנרות) are kept separate from the act/state of sanctifying them. The two sanctification forms differ grammatically (construct noun vs. relative verb clause) but denote the same act within the same Torah; merged at 'likely' rather than 'obvious'. A reviewer preferring strict under-merge could split them.
